title: An unposted sale and a suspense account
body: A trader's sales book for the month shows credit sales to four customers: Ashok Traders ₹20,000, Bimal Service Centre ₹10,000, Chopra Enterprises ₹5,000 and Diwakar and Sons ₹15,000, a total of ₹50,000. The total of ₹50,000 was correctly credited to Sales Account. The individual amounts were debited to the customers' accounts, except that the sale to Diwakar and Sons was not posted to his account. When the trial balance was prepared from these balances, the credit column totalled ₹50,000 and the debit column totalled ₹35,000. The accountant could not find the error immediately, so to carry on with the accounting process he put the difference into a suspense account. Later the omission was found.
